basic_info.description: 1059 Haight Street is a quintessential San Francisco Victorian 4-unit building, with an additional entrance at 11 Buena Vista, directly overlooking the beauty of Buena Vista Park. Meet agent at 11 Buena Vista for showings. This historic property is brimming with architectural character and charm, offering a rare opportunity for investors or owner-occupants seeking a centrally located building in one of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods.    Four unique units, each with its own character and style, enjoy direct access to a lush rear garden sanctuary via expansive rear decks. Front-facing upper units boast sweeping park views, while interior features include eclectic kitchens and baths, original fireplaces, and expansive, light-filled floor plans.    Perfectly situated between Buena Vista Park, Haight Street, and the Divisadero Corridor, the property provides immediate access to the city's best cafes, restaurants, shopping, and public transportation. Whether appreciating the serene garden, the historic Victorian details, or the proximity to San Francisco's cultural heart, this one-of-a-kind offering captures the essence of classic city living.
